title: sherpa-onnx official Rust crate v2.0.1 (k2-fsa)
notes: Verified live 2026-11-09 (crates.io API + docs.rs + k2-fsa docs + release notes + PR #4055 + issues #4139/#3172). Apache-2.0. Supersedes thewh1teagle/sherpa-rs (archived 2026-06-06). Relevance: sole VAD+STT+TTS+KWS dependency for Jerry SPEC-VOICE.

sections.heading: Crate facts
sections.body: v2.0.1 2026-10-27, Apache-2.0, default static feature, static-lib auto-download at build time, onnxruntime 1.28.2, CPU default / GPU manual (CUDA 12.8 + cuDNN 9), Tauri examples shipped, v2.0.0+v2.0.1 within 4 days.

sections.heading: Model coverage
sections.body: STT: Whisper, Moonshine v2, Qwen3-ASR, Parakeet TDT, Nemotron streaming, Zipformer. TTS: Kokoro, Pocket, Matcha, VITS, Kitten, Supertonic. VAD: Silero, Ten VAD. KWS: open-vocab Zipformer RTF 0.036.

sections.heading: v2.0.0 TTS frontend breaking change
sections.body: PR #4055 removed espeak-ng + piper-phonemize (GPL-free); data_dir deprecated/ignored; lexicon frontend; issue #4139 lexicon drops numbers/OOV; issue #3172 Pocket int8 quality root cause -> use fp32 bundle.
